profile.summary: Suraj Limited manufactures and sells stainless steel seamless pipes, tubes, U tubes, flanges, and fittings in India. It offers seamless instrumentation tubes, seamless heat exchanger tubes, seamless heat exchanger U tubes, and seamless buttweld fittings, as well as tubes, electro polished tubes, flanges and stub ends, carbon steel tubes, and forged rings.
